title: BADF-WP-G01-001: Build Gate 01 — PRD Review and Baseline
problem:
## Objective
Implement Gate 01 as the first full BADF lifecycle capability: `PRD Review and Baseline → PRD_BASELINED`.

## Scope
- canonical `badf-prd` skill
- Gate 01 machine-readable contract
- PRD baseline evidence/schema contract
- PRD baseline template/checklist
- deterministic validation entry point
- acceptance tests
- routing/integration with existing BADF delivery conventions where required

## Non-goals
- no production deployment authority changes
- no constitutional/authority policy expansion
- no implementation of Gates 02–14
- no direct edits to `main`

## Source baseline
- Enterprise Delivery Lifecycle Gate 01 definition
- Product Definition structure for PRD
- existing `badf-delivery` governance conventions

## Target disposition
`IMPLEMENTATION_READY → BUILT → ENGINEERING_VERIFIED` for the Gate 01 capability only. Gate authority remains deterministic and separate from skill execution.
note: Issue #41 is the human-authorized demand for the first G01 capability. Machine delivery identity is WP-2026-0025; the skill may prepare G01 evidence but may not issue PRD_BASELINED.
